data.summary: sharingu is one Cloudflare worker per org. People and their own AI clients file through one MCP door; every write is checked against the registry of kinds and shapes, previewed, then filed into the org's D1 database, and every screen reads D1 live. R2 keeps only blobs (render bodies by their hash, banked files, backups) and KV only the OAuth grants. sharingu runs no model: the person's own AI reads the input and extracts it.

nodes.title: The MCP door
nodes.about: One endpoint for every AI client: the tools to file (preview, then file; submit_grade) and to read. Its contract, contracts/door.json, is generated from the worker's own registries.

nodes.title: The REST twins
nodes.sub: the same doors, for a script or a form
nodes.about: Each MCP write has a REST twin (POST /knowledge, /preview, /file, /pack/grade, /respond) with the same checks.

nodes.title: The app
nodes.sub: Home, Build, Goals, the Map and more
nodes.about: Eight tabs: Home, Build, GTM, Goals, Decisions, Map, Broadcast and Control, behind a session cookie whose writes are same-origin checked.

nodes.title: The registry
nodes.sub: every kind and shape: format, example, place
nodes.about: One declaration of what each kind of knowledge and each contribution shape carries, where it shows and how it is checked. The door's checks, the formats read and the contract all read it.

nodes.title: Preview
nodes.about: Runs every item through the same checks the real write runs and answers where it will show and how it will be graded. Its one write is its own row.

nodes.title: File
nodes.about: Takes the preview's id and the same items, and files them through the existing write doors in one batch.

nodes.title: The grade at the door
nodes.sub: filed, with the owner, or one more thing
nodes.about: Every contribution is graded as it arrives and routed: filed at once, waiting in the owner's queue, or sent back naming what is missing. A check's grade counts only with its proof.

nodes.title: The sanitiser
nodes.sub: strips what in a screen could run
nodes.about: A screen's html and css are re-emitted from their own tokens with anything that could run or reach the network taken out, then shown only in a sandbox.

nodes.title: Live reads
nodes.about: Every page and every MCP read asks D1 at request time, through one bounded statement per region of a screen.

nodes.title: Knowledge
nodes.about: The aim, the goal tree, questions and their rulings, checks, the model's nodes and edges, docs, versions and the screens' render index.

nodes.title: The ledger
nodes.about: Every contribution with its grade and route, every check result, and the events, each attributed to a person.

nodes.title: Identity
nodes.about: The org's people, their role (Admin, Member or Partner), the projects they are seated on, and their keys.

nodes.title: Tallies and lights
nodes.sub: kept up by the write door
nodes.about: Counts and each node's light, maintained by the write door and triggers, so a screen never scans a table to count it.

nodes.title: Render bodies
nodes.sub: R2, once each, by content hash

crossing.rule: The MCP is the only input: every write comes through the one door and is checked against its kind.
Every screen reads D1 live: no page reads a published file.
A preview writes nothing to a project: its one write is its own row.
No script runs in a render: a screen's html is stripped at the door and shown only in a sandbox.
A Partner reads only the projects they are seated on.
Nothing crosses between orgs: a second org is a second worker with its own database and buckets.
